summary:
An export command naming one immutable image does not constrain its storage initializer to that image. At signed Skopeo1.21 source8bd9c541, GetStore opens the primary storage as writable and constructs global image/container stores; subsequent layer access initializes the global layer store and its recovery logic. The full export path acquires metadata/runroot locks. Duplicate names can cause whole-collection repair writes. Any loaded layer with boolean flags.incomplete=true can be deleted and affected layer metadata saved, even outside the selected image ancestry. Admission based only on selected-image config/layers or a generic lock/cache allowance misses these reachable effects.

Stale recovery already exists in1.21 layerStore.load: it visits graphroot/overlay-layers/tmp (the actual tempDirPath constant is tmp, not tempdirs) and driver temporary roots including graphroot/overlay/tempdirs.1.24.1 additionally calls recovery earlier during overlay Init; an earlier comparison that treated all recovery as newly introduced was incomplete. Choosing1.21 does not avoid stale deletion. Recovery and repair must be absent by determining current facts or explicitly within the permitted effect scope; this record selects no old cleanup, repair or historical replay.

Overlay initialization can create helper markers and feature caches and can run compatibility, metacopy or native-diff probes under the old graphroot. A private runroot can cause cache misses and new probes against the old graphroot; it does not establish independent storage. Actual backing, options, cache population, configured/autodetected helpers, quota and relevant writer interference determine the branch. Prefix-based temporary names alone are not ownership proof.

A valid selected-layer tar-split stream chooses reconstruction through DiffGetter, whose overlay implementation still checks composefs-data for selected and lower layers. Tar-split presence alone therefore does not prove mount/helper absence. Missing tar-split, naive-diff selection or parent mismatch can reach driver Get/Put and associated mounts/helpers; malformed existing tar-split is a refusal, not the missing-file fallback. Do not infer final driver shutdown or prune merely from a Cleanup method existing: storageImageSource.Close is a no-op.

The smallest source-supported allowance requires current whole loaded-store repair/recovery conditions, actual selected layer/parent/lower/tar-split/composefs closure, the precise initialization/cache/helper/backing branch and finite permitted writes. Keep immutable determining inputs separate from admitted mutable effects, and keep those facts valid under the relevant interference model. If current initializer reach includes unresolved old state, that interference is relevant to this export. Unrelated historical Unknowns still do not globally block demonstrated-independent fresh work under ADR0096. Public source research and a clean constructed fixture do not establish actual Home population, native compatibility, export fit or original retirement. Actual-store observations remain with the runtime owner in private custody.

A narrower supported1.21 alternative uses a fresh overlay primary/runroot with old overlayG ONLY as an additional read-only image store. Private [storage.options].additionalimagestores maps to overlay.imagestore; [storage].imagestore instead selects writable image storage. Set private CONTAINERS_STORAGE_CONF before initialization and keep HOME/XDG/runtime/temp/cache private. Source reference containers-storage:@FULL_IMAGE_ID then resolves through that configuration. A fresh VFS primary cannot consume old overlay metadata: the primary driver selects the additional metadata prefixes and shared driver.

The RO branches use old overlay-images/layers without old container/storage/userns initialization, stale-dir recovery or incomplete-layer cleanup. Fresh overlay initialization still has its own private probe/mount/helper/cache effects and needs actual qualification; the accepted VFS initializer does not qualify it. Existing tar-splits, immediate parents/lower links/diff directories and no composefs select direct DiffGetter reconstruction. Missing tar-splits or unavailable getter can still enter mount/helper fallback; preserve the exact branch rather than infer mount-free behavior from options.

This is not lock-free or one export snapshot. Old images.lock/layers.lock use O_RDONLY|O_CREAT with possible parent mkdir, so require actual existing lock identities and kernel-enforced RO backing; an unusable RO image store may be ignored on EROFS rather than proving lookup. Shared blocking read locks remain, and selected image/data/parent/tar-split/link/lock identities need retention and relevant concurrency closure. A layer lock lasts through reconstruction into a private spool; GetBlob closes that stream before returning the spool. Lock waits and io.Copy lack internal operation deadline or byte bounds: enforce external original containment/kill/settlement and aggregate spool/stage/archive backing. Cooperating writers can block or be blocked; physical RO write isolation alone does not remove selected-object interference or prove every host pause unnecessary. Root chose SOURCE PREPARATION of this narrower route in https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6403217422 . No physical RO view, fresh overlay qualification or native export acceptance is established by this source result.
title: Selected-image export still initializes and may repair the whole primary store
